items.name: Abdullah M.
items.text: Dr. Khalid took the time to explain every test result. The cardiac rehab team got me back to walking every evening within weeks.

items.name: Reem A.
items.text: I followed my whole pregnancy with Dr. Sarah. Booking online and getting WhatsApp reminders made everything so easy.

items.name: Imran K.
items.text: After my football injury I was worried about surgery. Dr. Omar's physio plan fixed my knee without it.

items.name: Hessa S.
items.text: Dr. Noura is wonderful with children. My son actually looks forward to his check-ups now!

items.name: Mark T.
items.text: Professional, spotless clinic and staff who speak excellent English. My implant was painless.

items.name: Fatimah Z.
items.text: My HbA1c dropped from 9.1 to 6.8 with Dr. Ahmed's diabetes programme. The dietitian sessions were a game changer.
